name: Doki Doki: World of Dreams
source:
A certain player (With a first and last name so keep that in mind when naming your character) is thrust into the world of Doki Doki Literature Club, possessing the body of the game's protagonist, Meiji Chizu. However, Meiji is still around, just relegated to backseat driver in his own body. Together, along with Monika, they try to prevent the events of the original game from happening. Will they succeed? Or will they fail?

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/kvetia/doki_doki_world_of_dreams_act_1_full_release/]Rediit[/url]]
translation:
某个玩家（有名字和姓氏，所以在命名你的角色时请记住这一点）被推入Doki Doki文学俱乐部的世界，拥有游戏主角Meiji Chizu的身体。然而，明治仍然存在，只是在他自己的身体里沦为后座司机。他们和莫妮卡一起试图阻止原游戏中的事件发生。他们会成功吗？或者他们会失败吗？

[来自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/kvetia/doki_doki_world_of_dreams_act_1_full_release/]Rediit[/url]]
